description: List the connected person's offers on Fabrica (Sepolia Testnet), across every wallet on their account: received, the offers waiting on their properties (per property, highest first, with whether the property is under a loan and the property page where an offer is accepted), and made, the offers they placed on other properties. Each offer has its USD price and amount, buyer, expiry, and expiringSoon when it ends within 3 days. Live offers only unless status is 'all'. Needs the connection's portfolio:read grant. get_land_order_book reads any one property's listings and offers.

side.description: 'both' (default), 'made': offers this person made, 'received': offers waiting on their properties

status.description: 'active' (default): live offers only. 'all': also expired, canceled and filled ones.

name: get_my_offers
title: Get my offers
